item.title: Homelab
item.description: Primary homelab machine; used for self-hosting, administration practice, and infrastructure experimentation. Hardware Machine: Lenovo ThinkPad T560 OS: Ubuntu Server (Noble Numbat; 24.04.4 LTS) CPU: Intel Core i5-6200U RAM: Kingston 16GB DDR3 Storage: Intel DC S3700-Series 1TB Enterprise SATA SSD Services Hosted Gitea Related Repositories Homelab Infrastructure Homelab Notes

item.title: Projects
item.description: This page is a personal collection of my deployment, Linux management, and infrastructure projects. Click one to open the GitHub repository. Homelab Infrastructure ThinkPad server IaC + infrastructure automation Dotfiles Main computer configuration files for the Fish shell, the Sway window manager, Vim, and other applications; mostly command-line tools. Scripts Bash automation scripts for system maintenance, productivity, networking, and the homelab. Notable Scripts pomo.sh Simple notification-based pomodoro timer. system-update.sh Runs a full system update and upgrade.
